premise: A bookkeeper at a failing salt mine finds that the company has been paying wages to forty workers who died in a collapse six years ago.
On a research station orbiting Titan, the only botanist wakes to find one plant has grown overnight into the air ducts, and the crew's oxygen readings have improved.
Two rival families share the last ferry to an island for a wedding, and halfway across, the bride's brother announces the groom is not on board.
A surveyor is hired to map a mountain valley before it is flooded for a dam, and the villagers keep moving the boundary stones at night.
A night cleaner in an office tower notices that a desk on the tenth floor is used every night, though the floor has been empty for a year.
In a walled city where bakers swear an oath never to refuse a loaf, a young apprentice is ordered by the governor to refuse one woman.
A string quartet's second violinist starts receiving letters that describe mistakes in performances before those performances take place.
A newly qualified nurse takes a post at a clinic on a tidal island, where the road floods twice a day and the only doctor has stopped coming back.
A retired postal inspector is asked by a ten-year-old neighbor to find out who has been stealing the racing pigeons from the rooftops of their block.
A long-haul trucker crossing a salt desert picks up a radio call from a driver who gives her own name and her own route, one day ahead of her.
